page_title: SAS 3-1 FIO | Sassuolo v Fiorentina 06/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Luca Pairetto has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+5' Mattia Viti (Fiorentina) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+4' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
90+3' It's like he was asking for a caution. Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card.
90+1' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Fiorentina fail to score from a corner as Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo) leaps to collect the ball.

90' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Fiorentina force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' A pass from Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Arijanet Muric and the move breaks down.
84' Substitution. Dodo did his best and is replaced by Christian Kouame (Fiorentina).
82' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) commits a foul during an attacking move.
78' Fabio Grosso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) replacing Cristian Volpato.
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sebastian Walukiewicz as he is replaced by Woyo Coulibaly (Sassuolo).

75' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Fiorentina are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
71' The corner from Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is hurriedly cleared.

70' A lofted cross from Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
70' The ball is cleared after Moise Kean (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
69' Sassuolo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

68' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Sassuolo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' 3 - 1 Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating David de Gea with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:1.
63' Here is a change. Luca Ranieri is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Mattia Viti (Fiorentina).
62' Here comes a substitution. Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Fabiano Parisi.
62' It is time for a substitution. Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) is on for Nicolo Fagioli.
61' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Referee Luca Pairetto has finally had enough of Fabio Grosso and gives him a straight RED CARD!
58' Goal disallowed! Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) scores but Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.

57' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
54' Today's match ends for Armand Lauriente who will be replaced by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
54' Andrea Pinamonti is substituted due to injury. Fabio Grosso gives a chance to Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo).
54' Dodo (Fiorentina) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
52' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Fiorentina will take a throw-in.
50' Fiorentina are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
47' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Paolo Vanoli probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Simon Sohm. He is replaced by Cher Ndour (Fiorentina).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.

45+1' 2 - 1 A perfectly taken corner kick. Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the roof of the net, increasing the score of today's match – 2:1.
45+1' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
45+1' A precise first-time shot by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sassuolo.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

45' A great solo effort from Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) and he attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a long-range shot low towards the middle of the goal. David de Gea has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
44' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
44' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. It will be a corner kick for Sassuolo.
44' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
43' Fiorentina are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
42' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) brings his opponent down. Luca Pairetto has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina will take a free kick near the side line.

41' Sassuolo exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will take a throw-in.
40' The free kick from long range, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
38' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
36' Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
35' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
35' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Luca Pairetto saw the whole situation.
34' The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
33' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
32' Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) commits a rough foul. Luca Pairetto stops the game and makes a call. Sassuolo are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
29' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) latches onto a short pass from Cristian Volpato inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
29' A neat pass is well received by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
27' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Luca Pairetto no option but to blow his whistle.

27' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
26' The corner from Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) is intercepted by the defence.

25' A pass lands at the feet of Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Sassuolo will have a corner.

24' Nice individual effort by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the middle of the goal, but David de Gea does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
23' Fiorentina are seeing far more of the ball now.
22' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
21' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) commits a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for an infringement. There is a free kick near the sideline to Fiorentina.
20' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
19' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Fiorentina was in an offside position.
19' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fiorentina.
17' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) makes a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
17' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
16' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) commits a foul and Luca Pairetto immediately signals a free kick.
14' 1 - 1 GOAL after a blunder! Keeper David de Gea makes a complete hash of a weak mid range shot from Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) and let’s the ball squirm into the net. It’s now 1:1.
13' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) heads on.

12' It looks like Moise Kean (Fiorentina) saw red with that tackle. Luca Pairetto won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Sassuolo are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
9' 0 - 1 GOAL! Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) sends the penalty kick into the right of the net.
9' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
7' Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Pairetto had an easy-decision to make.
7' A penalty is awarded to Fiorentina!
6' Fiorentina control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
5' David de Gea displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
4' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Pairetto blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Sassuolo.
3' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired high over the crossbar.
2' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is penalised for holding. Luca Pairetto signals a set piece. Fiorentina have a free kick from a promising distance.
1' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Sassuolo will take the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto will officiate today.
